title: Word 12 — On the Last Judgment (continued)
attribution_note: Word 12 of 28 in the collection Short Moral-Instructive Words — see Word 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: This word too is terrible, beloved: *“I will reprove you, and set your sins before your face.”* For this word also the great God speaks. To whom? To the sinner, as it is written earlier in the same psalm: *“God said to the sinner.”* Of what does He speak? That He will reprove the sinner for all his sins, and will set before his face all his lawless deeds. Where? At the universal judgment, where all the holy Angels will be present, and all people who have lived from the beginning to the end of the world will be gathered. At that universal assembly every sinner will be reproved, and his shameless and God-hating deeds will stand before him, and will be made known to the whole world.

*“I will reprove you, and set your sins before your face.* *You, O sinner, did this and that: when you saw a thief, you ran along with him, and were a partaker with adulterers; your mouth multiplied evil speech, and your tongue wove deceit; sitting, you slandered your brother, and set a stumbling block before your mother's son”* [Psalm 49:18–20].

Sinner! You break My law and utterly *“cast My words behind you,”* and do you think that all this will go unpunished, that I will not require it of you? *“Wherewith has the wicked man provoked God?* *In that he said in his heart, 'He will not require it'”* [Psalm 9:34/9:24 LXX]. No, no — it will not be as you lawlessly imagine and flatter yourself. For everything you have done I will require an account, and I will set before you all your lawless deeds, words, thoughts, undertakings, designs, and actions. Behold, sinner, you thought and devised this and that, you did and said this and that, and so you broke My eternal and unbreakable law, and despised and trampled the holy words of My mouth.

sections.heading: Each sin will confront its own sinner: the fornicator, the malicious, the thief

pairs.en: The thief and the plunderer will see before them all their thieving deeds, done secretly, or openly, or by deceit. Each of them will see where, and what, and from whom he brazenly seized, or cunningly appropriated, or secretly stole.

sections.heading: The dishonest merchant, the flatterer, the blasphemer

pairs.en: To the blasphemer and reviler there will be set before him all the blasphemies he poured out against God his Creator, and against His holy servants, and against other people made in the image of God; and he will be exposed as to where, when, and before whom he spoke those ruinous words.

sections.heading: Those entrusted with authority over others

pairs.en: To the lawless master there will be set before him all his insolence, violence, and cruelty toward his servants and peasants — how he tormented them inhumanly, or burdened them with unbearable labor and dues.

sections.heading: Even hidden sins, even worldly amusements

pairs.en: They will be set before you too, you lovers of pleasure and of the world. Your banquets will be set before you, your feasts, your balls, your operas, your masquerades, your dances, your games of cards, your hunts with hounds, and your other amusements — for you turned your heart away from the God you professed and gave it over to this vanity, turning your desire not toward God and His kingdom but toward the allurement of the world, and finding in it your comfort and merriment. Then, in place of that fleeting merriment, you will see your true and everlasting grief, sorrow, affliction, and sighing.

sections.heading: "Behold the man and his deeds" — spoken to every rank

pairs.en: At last every sinner who was not cleansed by repentance will hear: *“Behold the man, and his deeds!”*

sections.heading: Terror before the throne — and the door still open

pairs.en: Weep, weep, sinful soul; grieve and sigh that you have sinned against God! Ask, seek, and knock, that the Lord may open to you the doors of His mercy. *“Everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened”* [Matthew 7:8]. Glory to God the Lover of mankind for this, and let all people say: so be it! Amen.
